name: money-guard-mcp
description: Checks how a project handles money: float money columns in SQL migrations, unbalanced ledger exports and tampered audit logs. Read-only and offline.
long_description: money-guard lets Claude check a project that handles money. It runs the project's SQL migrations in a throwaway in-memory PostgreSQL and reports money columns stored as floats; it proves that every transaction in a ledger export (CSV, JSON or JSONL) nets to zero in whole minor units; and it verifies audit logs written with sealed-audit-chain. It only reads files inside the project folder you choose. It never edits files, never connects to a database and never uses the network.

tools.name: money_lint_schema
tools.description: Runs the project's SQL migrations in a throwaway PostgreSQL and reports money columns stored as float, numeric, smallint or the money type.

tools.name: money_check_double_entry
tools.description: Checks that every transaction in a ledger export (CSV, JSON or JSONL) nets to zero in whole minor units.

tools.name: audit_verify_chain
tools.description: Proves an audit log written with sealed-audit-chain was not edited, reordered or forged and, with an anchor from an earlier check, not cut short.

project_folder.title: Project folder
project_folder.description: The project the tools may read: its migrations, ledger exports and audit logs. Nothing outside it is read.

audit_keys.title: Audit log keys (optional)
audit_keys.description: Only for verifying audit logs: the HMAC keys as id=hex pairs separated by commas, such as k1=<64 hex digits>. Leave it blank otherwise.
